cards.name: Example Card
cards.note: Copy this file to card_map.json with your own cards. account_suffixes: the masked account number printed on the credit-card statement header. payment_last4: the last 4 digits in 'PAGO xxxx-xx**-****-NNNN' rows of the checking-account CSV (can differ from the account suffix). header_patterns: regexes matched (case-insensitive, uppercased text) against the statement header when the account number isn't listed; cards are tried in file order.
